careClaims.title: Pigeon fresh-produce variety and preparation

speciesEvidence.locator: VCA 'Fruits and Vegetables' section; Melbourne Bird Veterinary Clinic 'A range of fresh fruit and vegetables'; Modern Pet Pigeon Society 'Safe fruits and vegetables'; Palomacy 'Veggies or greens' section
speciesEvidence.rationale: The reviewed pigeon-specific sources support washed, finely prepared greens and vegetables with smaller fruit portions served separately from the dry diet. The Modern Pet Pigeon Society source now provides a direct pigeon-specific apple listing with seed-removal guidance. None supports treating fresh produce as a dry-formula component or a complete diet.

careClaims.proposedCopyBoundary: Supports the owner-approved pigeon-only Fresh Produce interaction: a button labelled 'View suitable fresh vegetables and fruit'; a guidance panel titled 'Suitable fresh vegetables and fruit for pigeons'; fresh, washed, finely chopped or grated vegetables and small fruit pieces served in a separate dish; examples of carrot, broccoli, cauliflower, bell pepper, dandelion greens, kale, romaine, collard greens, prepared apple flesh, and berries; and the explicit exclusion 'Do not offer avocado, onion, or rhubarb. Remove leftovers promptly.' It may provide an on-site 'Sources for this guidance' panel linking the VCA, Melbourne Bird Veterinary Clinic, Palomacy, Modern Pet Pigeon Society, and Pigeon Care Tips records. It must not imply that apple seeds, apple core, any fresh produce, or the examples listed are dry-formula ingredients, inventory additions, nutrient values, or automatic compatibility outcomes.
